features.title: Here's how it helps
features.subtitle: Not just search — the basis and the next thing to do, handled for you.
features.sourcedBody: Every answer shows the document, authority, base date, and a link to the original. No basis? It says “not confirmed” plainly.
features.datedBody: Time-sensitive facts always carry a base-date seal and a final-check note, so you can confirm with confidence.
features.nextBody: Filing documents and deadlines land in a checklist with a D-day. It doesn't stop at the answer.
features.oneBody: Search association materials, notices, and statutes by type, authority, region, and period — no site-hopping.

steps.askBody: Ask what you need in plain words, just like you'd say it.
steps.answerBody: Get the summary and key points with the source and base date.
steps.nextBody: Continue with follow-up questions and a checklist.

cta.title: Ask right now

about.title: We built a counter that hands you the evidence
about.lede: KHBA Assistant is run for association members by the association secretariat. It is not a search engine dressed up as a chat window. It is a consultation desk that answers, then shows you where the answer came from.
today: Search association materials, public notices and statutes together.
Summarise the answer in one sentence, then unpack the conditions.
Attach source cards with the issuing body and the base date.
Say plainly when the evidence is thin or missing.
notYet: Feasibility review or profitability modelling for a site.
Automated design or code compliance checking of drawings.
Replacing a filing decision. The official text and the competent authority still decide.
Answering on documents we do not hold. We tell you instead of guessing.
about.principlesTitle: How we decide what to say

principles.sourcesBody: An answer without a document behind it does not ship. If we cannot cite it, we tell you what is missing and what you can check instead.
principles.datesBody: Housing rules move. Every source keeps its base date so you can judge whether it is current for your case.
principles.limitsBody: We would rather narrow the promise than overstate it. The scope is stated in the product, not buried in a footnote.

about.roadmapBody: Next, we're building an in-place document viewer, so the cited passage opens where you are instead of sending you to another portal. Feasibility and design review remain out of scope until the evidence behind them is good enough to stand behind.

terms.title: Terms of use for KHBA Assistant
terms.versionNote: Version {version} · applies to all member accounts
terms.notice: Answers are reference material. Before filing or applying, the official text and the competent authority are what decide, so please confirm there.
terms.contactNote: Questions about these terms go to <link>assistant@khba.example</link>. Changes are announced at least seven days before they take effect.

articles.title: Article 1. What these terms cover
articles.body: These terms govern how members of the Korea Housing Builders Association use KHBA Assistant. By opening an account you accept them, and by continuing to use the service after a change takes effect you accept the changed version.

articles.title: Article 2. Who may hold an account
articles.body: Accounts are for verified member companies and the staff they nominate. The secretariat confirms the company against association records before an account is activated, and an account belongs to one person only.
items: Sharing credentials across staff is grounds for suspension.
Leaving a member company means the account is closed on request of the company.
A company may ask the desk to transfer or revoke the accounts it nominated.

articles.title: Article 3. What the service does, and does not do
articles.body: The service searches association materials, public notices and statutes, summarises what it finds, and cites the documents behind the summary with their base dates. It does not include feasibility review, profitability modelling, or automated checking of drawings.

articles.title: Article 4. Answers are reference material
articles.body: Answers support your judgement, they do not replace it. Before filing, applying, or committing money, the official text and the competent authority govern, and confirming there is your responsibility. The association is not liable for decisions made on an answer alone.

articles.title: Article 5. Base dates and revisions
articles.body: Every cited source carries the date the content reflects. Rules change, and a document that was current at its base date may since have been revised. Where we know a revision exists, we say so in the answer.

articles.title: Article 6. How your data is handled
articles.body: We keep the account details you provide, the questions you ask, and the answers returned, so the desk can improve coverage and resolve disputes.
items: Question history is retained for one year, then deleted.
Account details are kept while the account is open and for five years after closure where law requires.
Content is not sold, and is not shared outside the secretariat except where law compels it.

articles.title: Article 7. Things you agree not to do
articles.body: Automated bulk extraction, resale of answers as a commercial data product, attempts to bypass access control, and uploading material you have no right to share are all prohibited. We may suspend an account while we look into suspected misuse.

articles.title: Article 8. Interruptions and changes
articles.body: Maintenance, source outages and force majeure can interrupt the service. Planned maintenance is announced in advance where practical. Material changes to these terms are announced at least seven days before they take effect, and thirty days where the change reduces member rights.
